# Private room trial notes

Copy this template into a fresh directory under ignored `data/`; fill every unknown explicitly. Keep private audio, labels, locations and generated artifacts there. Do not commit tokens, credentials or raw audio. This form implies no permission for paid/external calls, uploads, publication or deployment.

## Trial and decision

- Trial ID / date / operator:
- Stage: hardware bench / home workflow / representative room:
- Recording/session group ID:
- Partition assigned before analysis: calibration / held-out evaluation:
- Related excerpts/preparations (same partition):
- Question and acceptance criterion written before results:
- Frozen policy/version (if any; unavailable detectors remain unavailable):
- Existing recorder tool/equipment actually used (application capture is Phase 6):
